Sanitized contract fragments captured from public provider pages on 2026-10-16.
Sources: savetwt.com, ssstwitter.com, tweeload.com, twittervideodownloader.com.
Only form inputs and download elements are retained. CSRF/session fields use
fixture values; signed and direct media URLs are replaced with media.example.
Premium-locked Tweeload rows and extensionless CDN links are deliberately kept.
These fixtures make contract assumptions reviewable; they do not guarantee that
an external service remains available or preserves its interface.
